answer: Social Matters >> Rights & Etiquettes Question ID: 57666 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: Relationship Question: My husband, his parents and siblings are not in good relation with my father-in-laws relatives. They don’t contact each other. In this case what is my responsibility? Answer ID: 57666 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 276/279/B=04/1436) Just maintain your relation with your husband and his parents well and show no interest in their internal affairs. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
